name: Vitko Runners, recommended configuration (warm starts + split tests)

workflow_input.split: true on workloads with a splittable test step

note: Warm starts: vitko-inc/checkpoint after the setup steps, captured from a push to the default branch; measured runs come from another branch. Split tests: vitko-inc/split-tests on the test step, with network-dependent tests in a separate unsplit step. Only the parts are billed while a split step runs.
